text: VBET is one of the brands listed by SoftConstruct, whose co-founders are Vahe and Vigen Badalyan; VBET was founded by Vigen and Vahe Badalyan in 2003. UK filings for VBET Sports Limited (company 10392319) name Vigen Badalyan (born January 1975) and Vahe Badalyan (born April 1970), both resident in Armenia, as persons with significant control, each with more than 25% but not more than 50% of the shares and voting rights.
short: VBET is a SoftConstruct brand, founded by Vigen and Vahe Badalyan
